rows.ARS:
Dark red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: DELadel
rows.Bloom: Dark red. None / no fragrance. Average diameter 4.5". Large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, exhibition bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Large, semi-glossy, medium green foliage.

Height: 31" to 39" (80 to 100cm). Width: 20" to 2' (50 to 60cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for cut flower, exhibition or garden. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Protect tender new spring growth from hard freezes that may cause canker, die-back and death of the plant. . Remove spent blooms to encourage re-bloom. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood.. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
